mapper.select: select id, name, type, amount, min_amount, start_time, end_time, total_count, per_user_limit, status, create_time from stad_coupon where status = 1 and id = #{id} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into stad_coupon (name, type, amount, min_amount, start_time, end_time, total_count, per_user_limit, status, create_time) values (#{name}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{minAmount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalCount}, #{perUserLimit}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update stad_coupon set name = #{name}, type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, total_count = #{totalCount}, per_user_limit = #{perUserLimit}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
